items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 This is one of my favorite games of all
items.summary: This is one of my favorite games of all time. Most games use so much storage space, and my 128 GB phone can barely take it, but Morimens use a reasonable 8 GB, sometimes even lower. It runs without glitches too, gameplay is smooth and enjoyable. The gacha system is one of the best I've ever seen too, and they are very generous when it comes to rewards. It's impossible to put my phone down when I'm playing this game.

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Finally tried out the game. The awkward
items.summary: Finally tried out the game. The awkward dialogue and confusing translation is noticeable.Gamenis buggy, and the powercreep is insane. Units need multiple dupes just to be viable for endgame. Not sure how the meta is rn considering 90% of units are useless. Gameplay is solid. It's different enough from CZN while having its own flair. Love the Cosmic horror atmosphere, but story is still generic. Art style is great, but UI is confusing and distracting. Overall, it's good but very flawed.
